crossRefs.note: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Ithiel
people.line: Descendant of Benjamin living in Jerusalem.

people.name: Jeshaiah
people.line: A descendant of Benjamin who lived in Jerusalem.

people.name: Joed
people.line: A Benjaminite who resettled in Jerusalem

people.name: Maaseiah
people.line: Descendant of Benjamin; lived in Jerusalem after the exile

people.name: Meshullam
people.line: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

people.name: Pedaiah
people.line: Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the exile

people.name: Sallu
people.line: Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the exile

translations.web: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
translations.bsb: From the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah;
translations.kjv: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
translations.asv: And these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
